title: Penniston touches craft and receives binary code
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Penniston touches craft and receives binary code, about December 1980 at Rendlesham Forest, England, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he stated that he touched the surface of the craft noting smooth glass-like material and unusual symbols etched on its side that resembled hieroglyphs according to peneston he experienced a profound telepathic download of binary code after touching the craft

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells what a man named Jim Penniston has said about a night in December 1980 in Rendlesham Forest in England. According to Penniston, he touched the surface of a landed craft, felt a smooth, glass-like material, and saw strange symbols on its side that looked like hieroglyphs, the picture writing of ancient Egypt. He says that touching it gave him a sudden telepathic download of binary code, the strings of ones and zeros computers use, which if true would mean the craft was trying to send a message.
